mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic effects and cardiovascular stimulation, which are potentiated in hyperthyroid states or with excessive levothyroxine dosing, increasing risk of tachycardia and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor heart rate and cardiac rhythm; ensure levothyroxine dose is optimized to euthyroid state; counsel patient on amphetamine-related cardiovascular symptoms and consider alternative ADHD therapy if thyroid function is difficult to control.
